evidenceBoundary.exact: Complete owned byte partition into checked code, table bytes and unreachable padding; full original branch grammar, signed byte/UInt16/dword widths, table reads and all actual direct/table targets. Both actual two-return index leaves are independently checked without inventing unwind extents.
evidenceBoundary.direct: The record and parameter scans conditionally compare or normalize stored carriers, test an opaque relation result, and produce a signed offset-plus-UInt16-selector pair address or zero. The two index leaves return zero for the dword minus-one sentinel, otherwise compute a header-offset/base/index address and preserve the volatile scan registers actually reused by the caller.
evidenceBoundary.structuralOnly: Anonymous class, record, context, carrier, variance-like flags and global storage. Table carrier substitutions do not assign named runtime types or select a live MethodInfo/interface target.
evidenceBoundary.conditional: Valid compatible stable selected native tables and receiver/context/record/parameter/carrier/stack/global/header/base storage. Preparation, carrier conversion and relation helpers return normally with compatible results and nonvolatile preservation. Leaf address arithmetic is not a bounds check or proof of live header/base identity.
evidenceBoundary.unresolved: Named runtime class/interface/generic context and slot meaning, selected live globals and initialization, conversion/relation side effects and results, live cache/setter, actual action callback/cursor, positive list and full root admission.
